status: AUTHORED PROVISIONAL INPUTS for the G4-R1 case / seal / support blocker-resolution study (G4_R1_BRIEF.md). Design variables, search grids, R1-authored planning values with evidence class, contract caps, evidence pins, owner decisions, lead adjudications, the C-R1-03 adjudication field and supplied LRA classes only. No result, margin, verdict, selected candidate, selected diameter or minimum diameter is authored here; every result is computed by tools/g4_r1_blockers.py.
evidence_policy: Every value carries one evidence class (G4_BRIEF section 6.1 and G4_R1_BRIEF section 9). PROVISIONAL_ASSUMPTION values are planning ranges with rationale and are never supplier, manufacturer, RF or material data. SUPPLIER_GATED terms enter linear-worst evaluations at their conservative planning limit and are never narrowed. MFG_TOL values are declared once per process class and are identical for every candidate using that class. Frozen G1/G2/G3/G4 values that the project exposes programmatically (reservations, process / material classes, O-ring windows and cross-section tolerance, bond lands, button windows, LRA classes, assembly steps) are referenced by id and read from the pinned sources at run time; they are never re-typed here.

architecture_projection.note: Canonical hash (g2_interconnect.dumps) of the read-only projection; the g1/g2/g3/g4 quotations and conflict statuses are excluded to avoid a circular hash.

lra_supplied_schema.lead_exit_rule: R2-3: lead_exit_envelope_mm = {length_mm, width_mm, height_mm: min/nom/max, exit: radial_out / radial_in / cw / ccw}; the lead / exit rectangle is attached to the body edge in the exit direction of the pose frame and is part of the physical envelope in every plan (global G4 exclusions, local exclusions, outer limit) and Z test (envelope height = max(body, lead)).
lra_supplied_schema.rule: C-R1-08: a supplied class counts only with a local primary document (repository path, existing file, not an R1 or generated file) and page plus table / figure provenance; a record missing any required field (lead / exit geometry included) is rejected and never suppresses the OD-G4-LRA-ARCH gate; a class defined by the threshold it must meet is rejected.

owner_decisions.verbatim:
Use:

W1 — rib/frame-supported window

as the Rev-A mechanical baseline.

Planning nominal thickness:

0.50 mm

This must preserve zero G4 Z delta.

0.30 mm sapphire remains an optimization / Rev-B lever only and is not credited to Rev-A closure.

Material and supplier qualification remain open.

No structural, optical, adhesive or 5 ATM qualification is implied.

W0 remains rejected under current Rev-A thickness constraints. W2 remains rejected under current seal-land geometry.

Rev-A assembly clarification:

The display is mated and seated from the open front before the cover is bonded.

This supersedes the prior cover-first ordering only where the latter conflicts with the continuous display support
land.

No allocation, stack, placement or architecture change is authorized.

SERVICE-COVER-REBOND remains OPEN.

lead_adjudications.verbatim:
I_T in G4_R1_BRIEF §6.5 means the composite T-section inertia about its own
neutral axis MINUS the flange self-inertia contribution.

The structural formulation must satisfy:

h_rib -> 0  =>  D_r -> D_plate

No zero-height-rib stiffness bonus is permitted.

Screen A is the brief-literal per-region isotropic-equivalent-thickness screen:

t_eq = (12*(1-nu^2)*D_r/E)^(1/3)

evaluated through the accepted G4 annular-plate formulation.

Screen A is REPORTED.

A directional polar-orthotropic Screen B is also required and GOVERNS.

R1-H09 physical PASS requires both applicable screens to pass.

No invented inner caseback support is permitted.

Use the accepted G4 bypass / loaded-boss boundary semantics.

Circumferential ring stiffness receives NO structural credit in R1.

A ring may be represented geometrically but cannot improve the analytical
stiffness result.

Interrupted ribs do not count as continuous ribs.

Only ribs continuous over the required structural radial interval receive rib
stiffness credit.

For rib spacing use the largest angular gap at the relevant radius.

`h_pod` keeps the accepted G4 meaning:

h_pod = 0.0

for the caseback outer-face / pod-plane datum.

The G3 optical-pod depth is a separate variable named:

pod_depth

Do not conflate them.

The rear conductor/FPC band exists below the lower web over the entire
periphery unless a pinned plan footprint proves otherwise.

Ribs, LRA, charger and other internal features must respect that Z volume.

The C-R1-02 rim / groove / flexure term is physically located in the common
button section and is NEVER omitted.

T3 is selectable only if a complete flexure model exists and passes.

Otherwise:

NOT_SELECTABLE

with the governing required threshold reported.

Residual caseback thickness below an LRA pocket must be at least the adverse
G4 material-class wall minimum plus the relevant manufacturing tolerance.

The current R1 V22 values are defective where they permit less.

At minimum preserve these G4 adverse material-class floors:

ceramic: 0.8 mm
metal:   0.7 mm
polymer: 1.0 mm

plus applicable process thickness tolerance.

Use the accepted G4 A1..A11 operation identities, directions and battery-state
semantics.

C-R1-06 does NOT authorize rewriting the whole assembly sequence.

Only the selected button topology may change A9's part content.
Use the explicit hard-check state model in S6 below.

V03_corridor_arcs.rationale: C-R1-04: local arcs over the frozen corridor reservations (azimuths read from architecture.json); each arc extends 1.5 deg beyond its corridor on both sides; floor = local material t_wall_min(max) + local bore radius tol + local OD tol.

V05_button_topologies.T1: dynamic radial pusher O-ring (G4 pusher_gland); regression only, never selectable
V05_button_topologies.T2-R: rigid plunger in an unsealed guide bore; elastomer boot / bonded diaphragm recessed in a counterbore; boot outer surface inside the boss envelope
V05_button_topologies.T2-F: rigid plunger in an unsealed guide bore; elastomer boot rim bonded / face-sealed on the boss face; boot protrudes beyond the boss face
V05_button_topologies.T3: metal case-integral flexure web (non-ferromagnetic metal midcase only); selectable only with a complete flexure model and authored minimum-web evidence (LA-BTN-2)

V07_boot_rim_land.rationale: C-R1-02 rim / groove term and boot rim land; adverse authored value used for closure (never replaced by 0.8).

V08_boot.rationale: Authored boot free-height planning value (input, not a derived pass); strain screen h_boot >= stroke / strain_hard_max.

T3_flexure.rationale: No authored machining minimum web exists; T3 is NOT_SELECTABLE until evidence is supplied (LA-BTN-2).

V11_main_seal_cs.rationale: Windows and cross-section tolerance are read from g4 parameters.oring (never widened or narrowed); the diagnostic extension only locates zero-margin thresholds.

V12b_flange_thickness.rationale: Explicit caseback seal-flange thickness under the midcase rear-face annulus; groove residual and Z modeled.

V14_rib_geometry.tolerance_rule: rib height tol = caseback process thickness_mm; rib width tol = caseback process groove_width_mm
V14_rib_geometry.evidence_class: DESIGN + MFG_TOL; K_t PROVISIONAL (lead planning value)

V18_window.rationale: W1 inter-cell rib width and its tolerance (moved from the tool into inputs).

V19_charger_pose.block_size_source: must equal g4 parameters.charger_block_min (radial, tangential); never reduced

route_clearance.subject: the non-conductive bond/seal land (C-R1-01 item 2)
route_clearance.contract_text: (v) clears screws, supports, CHG_ROUTE and CHG_LINK in plan and in Z, and
route_clearance.rule: C-R1-01 2(v): the non-conductive bond/seal land (v) clears screws, supports, CHG_ROUTE and CHG_LINK in plan and in Z.

clearance_semantics.evidence_class: MODEL (R3-3 strict clearance rule; not contract text)
clearance_semantics.rule: a plan or Z gap separates only when strictly positive (touching counts as a collision); a Z separation never waives a plan collision of the land; C-R1-01 2(vi) neighbours use the common strict 3-D clearance.

block_and_z_screen.evidence_class: LEAD / MODEL CONSERVATISM (not contract text; never decides R1-H14)
block_and_z_screen.rule: optional diagnostic screen: the conductive contact block plan AND Z separated from the 2(v) items and strictly below the CHG_ROUTE / CHG_LINK conductor band. C-R1-01 item 1 states no plan-AND-Z rule for the block; the block is held to item 1 and the common strict 3-D clearance.

V21_feedthrough_topologies.FT-B: insert-moulded block in a polymer caseback
V21_feedthrough_topologies.FT-C: bonded sealed body in a ceramic / metal caseback

V22_lra_pocket.grid_source: g4 lra_search (az 0-355 step 5, r step 0.25, orientations 0 / 90)
V22_lra_pocket.residual_floor_rule: LA-LRA-1: residual >= caseback material t_wall_min(max) + caseback process thickness tolerance
V22_lra_pocket.historical_residual_note: Old 0.5 mm residual assumption of the brief section 6.8 estimate; reported as the optimistic historical bound only, never credited.

V24_screws.locations: lug roots; outside the seal line (computed)

V25_cover.source: G4 cover / land search (a_cover, t_land, w_land) re-evaluated at the R1 point
